recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. If OO wants a label-free or hyperlinked diagram, regenerate the diagram from its source-of-truth and land that as a dedicated human-reviewed diagram update rather than hand-editing the SVG here.
issue_request: FHIR-50444 was an Applied, Not Persuasive with Modification OO R6 ballot issue asking that Device module diagram arrows show element names; the modified resolution rejected simply adding all labels and pointed to a resource-link/revised-diagram approach plus a Practitioner relationship fix.
initial_application: No FHIR-50444-tagged source commit was found. Jira says the change was applied in FHIR-50445, and HL7/fhir PR #3836 / commit ff73a37610 added the current DeviceModule.svg, registered it in publish.ini, and changed source/device-module.html to describe the diagram as representative and direct readers to resource pages for all valid relationships.
additional_context: The Device module page is active build source through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and DeviceModule.svg is registered as a published image. The combined branch already contains FHIR-50445 and FHIR-50446 audit commits from the same PR #3836 application trail. OCR confirms the current SVG renders relationship labels and resource names, but the SVG is a generated-looking Lucid artifact with path/glyph content rather than an authoritative relationship source.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current page prevents the diagram from being read as exhaustive, active resource definitions provide the authoritative relationship details, and reworking only the SVG would be outside the source-edit threshold for this reconciliation.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-50444's Jira application comment says the change was applied in FHIR-50445; that issue's PR #3836 added the current SVG and page wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
FHIR-50439 supplied the same DeviceModule.svg diagram update attachment and was reviewed in the same Device module diagram-ticket batch.
PR #3836 also carried Device module use-case text for FHIR-50446, which is already represented on the combined branch.
